name: Anheuser-Busch Brewery - Van Nuys (Los Angeles) CA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Anheuser-Busch Los Angeles (Van Nuys) Brewery, 15800 Roscoe Blvd. Roster coords were rooftop-accurate (movedMeters 55). Locked center on the main brewhouse/warehouse mass at 34.21850,-118.47900. Street View on the E street shows brewery storage tanks behind a hedge, and the Roscoe Blvd frontage carries a 'Bud...' building sign.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding gate across the main entrance off Roscoe Blvd at the NE corner (34.2210,-118.4775); Street View shows a sliding security gate with a wide multi-lane apron. A second gated truck entrance serves the SW/rail side. truckGateCount 2.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Z20 satellite shows a distinct rounded guard-booth structure on a paved island at the NE entrance, with a vehicle parked beside it; Street View confirms a small booth just inside the gate.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate opens directly onto Roscoe Blvd, a busy 4-6 lane urban arterial; minimal stacking room outside the gate so a truck queue would spill onto the road.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight urban campus - gate-to-dock approach is short, no long internal queue lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band. Dock canopies and backed-in trailers visible along internal building faces; rooftop solar obscures the count, estimate ~45.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer yards within the campus SW corner plus a sizable trailer yard across Roscoe Blvd to the NW; well over 50 stalls. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces around the brewhouse and warehouses.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multi-track rail line runs along the SE/S edge of the campus with rail siding into the property; trailers staged alongside.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 8+ large structures - brewhouse with tank farm, packaging warehouses, ancillary buildings, plus the detached NW trailer yard across Roscoe Blvd.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense San Fernando Valley industrial fabric within metro Los Angeles - Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron at the NE entrance offers room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.operatingStatus: Active brewery (95 acres, 1.7M sq ft, ~12M barrels/yr per industry sources); offers public tours.
